speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The mission of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) is to uphold Singapore's independence and sovereignty while advancing the interests of Singapore overseas and providing consular services to Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Even as we deal with the massive health, economic, and social impact of the pandemic, we need to maintain our engagement on the global stage.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: COVID-19 has reinforced how important it is for Singapore to continue to play an active role internationally and deepen our interactions with key stakeholders and at multilateral fora.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The fight against COVID-19 is a global one and we cannot win it alone.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Prior to the COVID-19 outbreak, more Singaporeans than ever were living, working, studying, and travelling overseas.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: COVID-19 has deeply affected these overseas Singaporeans and their families.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: In the weeks and months following the outbreak, we saw numerous Singaporeans return home.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: MFA officers, together with other Ministries and agencies, were heavily involved in these repatriation efforts.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Our officers worked around the clock and went beyond the call of duty to help their fellow Singaporeans in their time of need.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Singaporeans know that we will leave no Singaporean behind.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: MFA worked closely with our international partners on these repatriation missions.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: In the months since, we have continued to work with the international community to cope with the travel and movement restrictions imposed by the pandemic while safeguarding Singapore's interests and Singaporeans' welfare.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: COVID-19 will continue to be a threat for the foreseeable future and we must be prepared for the uncertainty that lies ahead.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: For those Singaporeans who have chosen to remain abroad, their families here are understandably concerned about their well-being.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: MFA remains committed to helping overseas Singaporeans and doing our part to bring peace of mind to their families at home.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: As a small nation-state, developing strong, sustainable, and multi-faceted partnerships is vital for Singapore's long-term security and continued prosperity.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Maintaining and strengthening our relations with our immediate neighbours, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Brunei, is more critical than ever as we work to maintain supply chains for essential trade and overcome the longer-term socio-economic impact of the pandemic.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We are also discussing measures to progressively restore cross-border travel between Singapore and Malaysia while ensuring the health and safety of the citizens of both countries.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We are also keeping up our strong and mutually-beneficial cooperation with Indonesia and will explore ways to support each other's economic recovery.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: ASEAN continues to be a cornerstone of Singapore's foreign policy, serving as the necessary bedrock for a stable, peaceful, and prosperous region.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Singapore will continue to work closely with our fellow ASEAN Member States, as well as ASEAN's external partners, to enhance ASEAN's global footprint.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We share substantive and growing economic, defence, and people-to-people ties with our Southeast Asian neighbours and are developing new areas of cooperation such as smart city infrastructure, FinTech, digital technology, innovation, as well as agri-trade to secure and diversify our supply chains.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: For instance, we are cooperating with the US on emerging areas such as cybersecurity and infrastructure financing.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: With China, we will leverage on the Joint Council for Bilateral Cooperation to expand bilateral cooperation in a wide range of areas including public health.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: At the same time, we will continue with our active engagement of other key partners including India, Japan, the Republic of Korea, Australia, and the European Union, and explore ways to enhance cooperation in areas such as public health, reciprocal green lanes, and supply chain connectivity.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will have to work together with friends in the international community to ensure fair and equitable access to vaccines for people in all countries.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Beyond the pandemic, we are strengthening cooperation with international partners in areas such as vocational education and sustainable development.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: MFA will continue to enhance relations with countries in other regions including the Middle East, Central Asia, Latin America, and Sub-Saharan Africa.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: As we navigate the challenging times ahead, we must ensure that first and foremost, we are strong and united as Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: This will strengthen our credibility when we work with external partners to strengthen our bilateral relations, regional standing, and international presence.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: In the spirit of SG Together, we will continue to ensure Singaporeans are aware of the Government's collective efforts to address challenges brought about by the COVID-19 pandemic, increase our relevance, and expand our space on the global stage.
